blocker: SenseVoiceSmall is a five-language released checkpoint without Russian ASR, Russian hinting, Cyrillic tokenizer pieces, current Fluid word timing/confidence output, or product vocabulary candidateRegions semantics.

analysis.normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; Russian ё->е; Unicode punctuation/symbol/separator/control to spaces; collapse whitespace; WER by spaces; CER without spaces.
analysis.bootstrap: paired stratified resampling within language x duration-bin cells

promotion_rule: The 204 run is forbidden until a new versioned adapter closes every source capability blocker and the frozen four-fixture smoke passes. If it is ever unblocked, integrate only if every quality, latency, resource, privacy, and lifecycle gate passes; otherwise reject.

pre_inference_eligibility: exact English hint only; never nil/auto, Russian, or mixed-language
no acoustic vocabulary or candidateRegions requirement
caller explicitly accepts text-only output with no word timing/confidence
all nine local model artifacts exactly verified and offline mode active
routing_fallback_policy.ordinary_shipping_fallback: On any preflight mismatch, use shipping exactly once before candidate inference. On candidate load/inference/empty-output failure, tear down the candidate generation and invoke shipping exactly once; report the added latency. Never silently substitute fp32 SenseVoice because it is a different compute route and a 944 MB artifact set.
routing_fallback_policy.current_product_effect: The normal product has auto/mixed EN+RU semantics and, when installed, a 28-term candidateRegions vocabulary path; therefore current safe eligibility is effectively zero.
